content: Flutter offline-caching default stack: Drift (SQLite wrapper) for structured/relational cached data with type-safe queries and schema migrations; repository pattern owns caching (fetch remote -> write-through to Drift -> UI reads from Drift as single source of truth, 'pull-through cache'). Hive/shared_preferences suited for ephemeral/simple key-value data, not relational band/track/setlist data. connectivity_plus is the standard package for detecting online/offline state to gate mutations.
